desc: Parse input into `small = [v for v in nums if v <= threshold]` and `large_count = n - len(small)`.
Initialize DSU parent/size for values `0..threshold`, a `present` boolean array, and `first = [-1] * (threshold+1)`.
For each present `v`, iterate multiples `m = v, 2v, ... <= threshold`; if `first[m]` is unset set it to `v`, otherwise `union(v, first[m])`.
After processing all small values, compute `len({find(v) for v in small})` and add `large_count`.
Prove/verify correctness with the divisor-clique argument and test edge cases: `1`, all values `>T`, duplicates disallowed, chain connections through different `L`.
Analyze complexity as `O(threshold log threshold + n α(threshold))` time and `O(threshold)` memory, then implement in the starter method.
Implement the full solution in the starter code (DSU + sieve union via `first[m]`), and validate against examples and edge cases.
